name: Star winding connection
summary: A star winding joins one end of each phase winding at a common point.
description: A star winding joins one end of each phase winding at a common point. The external phase terminals and the common point determine the winding topology.
readingNotes: Check whether the common point is internal or brought out as a neutral terminal.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: A drawn star point does not mean that it is accessible for external connection.
